title: Chapter 2836 - 134: All Black_3
content:
Chapter 2836: Chapter 134: All Black_3

Dan Zhu was filled with excitement.

This was the vision that Mo Hua had been instilling in him, and now this vision had finally unveiled its curtain.

But Lu Gu, Chi Feng, and some other Shugubu Golden Cores frowned slightly. They vaguely felt something was amiss in these words about "divine authority," but couldn’t quite figure out what was wrong.

And in such an atmosphere, the tribal forces of Can Gu had been largely absorbed by Mo Hua and Lu Gu.

Lu Gu’s military strength further increased.

And Mo Hua’s power and influence also surged.

With the title of Shaman, he directly or indirectly commanded over 300,000 barbarian cultivators.

Mo Hua had, in a truly significant scope, attained the fame and momentum of a "Shaman."

The next step was to send troops to conquer Chief Shugou.

Kill this supreme ruler of the Shugubu, swallow the remaining forces, and then Shugubu could directly change its surname.

But conquering Chief Shugou faced an irreconcilable contradiction.

Currently, Mo Hua’s power structure mostly relied on Lu Gu, as well as the Shugubu’s barbarian soldiers, barbarian cultivators, and barbarian slaves.

Most of these people were from Shugubu.

Having them fight among other Shugubu tribes for territory might not be a big issue, as there were already many internal conflicts.

But to attack the Great Chief constitutes blatant "treason."

The Great Chief, endorsed by the Shugubu ancestor, was the highest commander and symbol of the Shugubu.

"Conquering" the Great Chief was akin to rebellion, akin to betraying one’s roots, an unforgivable crime.

Ordinary Shugubu barbarian cultivators, no matter how confused, understood this much clearly.

If these Shugubu barbarian cultivators knew their mission was to conquer the Chief Shugou.

The team would disperse instantly.

Lu Gu, eager for revenge, was at a loss on how to proceed, and so gravely approached Mo Hua.

Mo Hua calmly sipped tea and asked Lu Gu, "Have you ever heard of ’bringing order to the emperor’s side’?"

"Bringing order to the emperor’s side?"

Lu Gu had never heard of it and was taken aback.

Mo Hua continued, "Our mission is not to conquer the Great Chief, but to conquer Can Gu."

"When Can Gu falls, he will certainly bring his loyal followers and seek refuge with the Great Chief."

"You should put all the blame on Can Gu. Say the Great Chief is old, has been deceived by Can Gu, who harmed your brother, and your mission is to help the Great Chief by eradicating the traitor and slaying Can Gu."

"Then you enter the base, kill the Great Chief, and claim Can Gu killed the Great Chief, leaving you stricken with grief. Then kill Can Gu, avenging the Great Chief."

"Then I’ll have someone suggest making you the Great Chief. After all, you killed Can Gu and avenged the Great Chief, and among the tribe, you are the strongest."

"In this way, you openly and honorably get your revenge and become the Great Chief, rightfully so..."

Mo Hua spoke calmly and fluently.

Lu Gu stood there, stunned, not recovering for a long time.

"Then..." Lu Gu frowned and said, "What if the Great Chief directly hands over Can Gu to me to withdraw my troops?"

Mo Hua shook his head, "The Great Chief is not foolish. He knows more clearly than anyone else and would never hand Can Gu over to you, cutting off his own arm."

"What if he really does hand him over?" Lu Gu asked.

Mo Hua said, "Then you win over Can Gu, put all the blame on the Great Chief, promise benefits, and deceive Can Gu into joining you in killing the Great Chief."

"Can Gu, betrayed by the Great Chief, will harbor anger and most likely turn against him..."

"After killing the Great Chief, you kill Can Gu as well, pushing all the blame back onto Can Gu, and the result remains the same..."

Mo Hua spoke in a plain tone, as if discussing trivial matters.

Lu Gu, however, felt a chill run through his heart. He stared blankly at Mo Hua, thinking that perhaps Mo Hua’s entire being, except for his face, was white.

His insides, organs, all were black.

Even the blood he bled was probably black, too.

"This person must be a Demon Monster," Lu Gu thought silently.

After all, someone who could be so ’wicked’ likely couldn’t be human...
